criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.basis: OSM way/860918857 tags match exact building name and 333 Meridian; closed 19-vertex outline; official congregation history HTML also supports address/history. Exact source snapshots present.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.basis: Reprojected OSM source ring with repository transform and compared with unique mesh grade vertices; symmetric vertex-set Hausdorff error=0.000036 m; source bbox=[[360.0464578640481, 418.260456562517, 710.644895999792, 756.1935040003004]]; model bounds incl. overhangs=[360.04644775390625, 418.2604675292969, 710.6448974609375, 756.7434692382812]. This validates against OSM, not survey control.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.basis: Source photo supports a gabled sanctuary silhouette; no measured eave/ridge elevation or reliable floor count was found. Model world z=[0.0, 10.390000343322754] m, with evidence correctly labeling 4.5/5.4/10.2 m as visual estimates.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.basis: The retained exterior photo visibly shows the gabled stained-glass frontage, paired doors, and low side wings. The mesh has stained-glass materials and window/facade faces; these features are represented, but modeled frontage/mullions/materials remain simplified and only one facade photo is available.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.basis: Saved asset reopened in Blender; expected object and export collection retained with one mesh; file name/ID stable; no image/texture objects required by the mesh; source snapshots, structured evidence, builder, and preview script/render all exist. Manifest kind remains campus-frame massing, matching current coordinate frame.
